systemContinuityCheck.note: Section 25.0 requires an architectural compatibility answer for every domain, not scaffolding for future features. NOT_YET_IMPLEMENTED — NO CONFLICT INTRODUCED is the correct answer where Phase 0 does not touch the domain.

domains.squareGridTacticsAnd3dGeometry: NOT_YET_IMPLEMENTED — NO CONFLICT INTRODUCED. No coordinate model of any kind exists yet, and the greenfield scan actively blocks an alternate topology or compatibility switch from appearing before Phase 2 authors the single five-foot square model.
domains.canonicalCommandEventProjectionAuthority: PARTIAL — COMPATIBLE. Phase 0 establishes the direction of authority: the browser submits intent with a request identifier, the server validates and commits, and the page renders only a server-produced projection with a monotonic projectionVersion. Phase 2 extends this into the full command/event/projection core rather than replacing it.
domains.multiplayerSeatsPresenceReconnectOwnersh: PARTIAL — COMPATIBLE. Account-scoped ownership is enforced server-side on every read and write, and session resolution is server-side and revocable. Seats, presence, and reconnect belong to Phases 2 and 4.
domains.deterministicSrdRulesEngine: NOT_YET_IMPLEMENTED — NO CONFLICT INTRODUCED. No rules logic exists; nothing in Phase 0 computes a mechanical outcome.
domains.aiDirectorIntentRulingNarrationIsolation: NOT_YET_IMPLEMENTED — NO CONFLICT INTRODUCED. No AI provider, prompt, or model call exists in this candidate, and the outbound-origin assertion proves the page reaches nothing beyond loopback.
domains.campaignPersistenceAndMemory: NOT_YET_IMPLEMENTED — NO CONFLICT INTRODUCED. Persistence is proven generically through the emulator; no campaign schema is invented ahead of Phase 1.
domains.playerAndCampaignSettings: NOT_YET_IMPLEMENTED — NO CONFLICT INTRODUCED. No settings model is speculated; Phase 1 owns it.
domains.communicationSurfacesAndSafety: NOT_YET_IMPLEMENTED — NO CONFLICT INTRODUCED. The Phase 0 page has one purpose-built form and no chat surface, so no surface boundary is prejudged.
domains.accessibilityBrowserBehaviorDegradedMode: PARTIAL — COMPATIBLE. The page is keyboard operable, uses a skip link, labelled controls, a live region, alert roles for failures, and honors reduced motion. Full browser and device certification belongs to Phase 6.
domains.securityPrivacyProviderPolicyHiddenInfor: PARTIAL — COMPATIBLE. Origin guard, http-only SameSite=Strict session cookie, hashed session tokens, ownership-scoped queries, deny-all client rules, and fail-closed environment guards are active. Provider policy and hidden-information projections arrive with the features that need them.
domains.artAudioPerformanceRenderingLayerOwnersh: NOT_YET_IMPLEMENTED — NO CONFLICT INTRODUCED. No renderer, asset pipeline, or layer registry exists. The Phase 0 page is a small operator surface and does not claim to be the Design System Manifest that Phase 1 owns.
